newsitem.title: UK: UK's Orange launches group services.
newsitem.headline: UK's Orange launches group services.

text.p: Orange Plc is targeting small and medium-sized businesses with new services to facilitate group communications, the UK mobile phone company said on Wednesday.
The services will allow simultaneous voice or text messaging of up to 25 Orange phones.
Other innovations are a conference call facility to allow up to six people to talk together and a mechanism to group 50 handsets on the same bill.

The launch of the new services will be supported by a seven million stg national advertising campaign which will run on TV from June 8 and also cover press, radio and posters. Orange said it believed the services would appeal to a large number of its existing 930,000 subscribers and attract new customers.

"We believe that the services will have considerable relevance to the business market and our research indicates that they will appeal to a broad range of small to medium-sized businesses," said Robert Fallow, group director of marketing.

"Customers will benefit from savings on the cost of connection and by value for money tariffs and by cost effective Orange to Orange rates. Orange will benefit from greater call volume, attracting new customers and, we believe, strengthen customer loyalty," he added.
The voice messaging service is being introduced on Wednesday (today) while group text messaging will be added next month.
Under the conference call plan, only the initial caller needs a compatible Orange phone, the others can be on any fixed or mobile line.
